chapter.verse: Khangham upate na taai kei in, pa bangin na thuum in. Tangvalte na sangampa bangin ahi zongin,
nupite nute bangin ahi zongin, nungakte na khempeuhah a siangtho tawh ahi zongin thu na hilh in.
Meigong taktak ahi numeite na zahtak in.

Ahih hangin ta leh tu a nei meigongnu ahih leh, a tute a tate in a masa-in amau innkuanpihte zahtakin, a pa, a pite’ hehpihna thukkik nading sin uh hen. Bang hang hiam cih leh, tua bang hihna in Pasian mai-ah a deihhuai ahi hi.
Meigongnu taktak hi a, khat guak a om lai numei in Pasian muang a, sun tawh zan tawh thungenin a om tawntung hi.
Ahih hangin a mawktatna-ah, nopsa-a a om meigongnu ahih leh, a nuntak hangin si-in a om hi.
Tua mite in mawhsakna tawh a kipelh nadingun hih thute vaikhak in.
Mi khat in ama mite, ahi takpi gen leeng ama innkuanpihte, a kep kei leh, thu-upna nial a, a um lo mite sangin a gilo zaw hi.
Meigongnu in kum sawmguk a phak kei leh, a min na khum kei in. Amah in pasal khat a nei ngei,

na pha sem a, maipha a ngah, a tate a khoi thei, zin a do thei, mi siangthote’ khe a sil thei, gimna thuakte a hehnem thei, nasepna a pha khempeuh a sem thei numei ahih leh, tua numei a min na khum ta in.
A khangno lai meigongnute ahih uh leh, a min uh khum kei in. Bang hang hiam cih leh, tua numeite in nopsakna lungsim nei-in, Khazih tawh kilem loin pasal nei nuam uh a,
a masa thuciamna siasak uh ahih ciangin thukhenna a thuak uh hi.
Tua tham loin, inn khat pan inn khatah vak kawikawi-in, thadah tham loin, kam tamin, a gen tuak lo nate genin, amau tawh kikum lo thu-ah a kihel thei uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin a khangno meigongnute in pasal a neih nading, ta zong a neih nading, a inn sung a uk nading, i galte in hong gensiat theih loh nading ahih nadingun ka deih hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh, a kimkhat in tu lai nangawnin Satan nung a zui uh hi.
Thu-um numei khatpeuh in a inn sungah meigongte a neih leh, pawlpi tungah van suan loin amahmah in vaak hen. Tua bang ahih leh, meigongnu taktak ahi-te pawlpi in a vaak thei ding hi.
Pawlpi a pha takpi-a ukte, a man takpi ci leeng Pasian’ thu gen a, thuhilhin a hahkatte in, a zah nih zahtakna ngah ding a kilawm na ciamteh in.
Bang hang hiam cih leh: “Buh a cil bawng’ kam na hencip kei in,” leh “Nasemte in thaman ngah ding a kilawm hi,” ci-in Lai Siangtho in a gen hi.
Teci nih bang thum bang a om kei leh, pawlpi ukpa tungah mawhsakna kam na ngai kei in.
Midangte in zong a lau theih nadingun, a khial mite, mi khempeuh mai-ah na taai in.
Thu ma khen loin, gup tuam neihna lungsim tawh bangmah bawl loin, hih thute na zuih nadingin Pasian’ mai, Khazih Zeisu’ mai leh a kiteel vantungmite mai-ah pha takpi-in thu kong pia hi.
Thu ngaihsun masa loin kuama tungah a manlangin khutngakna nei kei in. Midangte mawhna tawh na kikum kei in, nangma nuntakna siangtho sak in.
Na gilpi ading leh na cinatna ading tu-a kipan tui bek dawn loin leenggahzu tawm na zang in.
Mi kimkhatte a gitlohna uh kilangin thu kikhen masa thei hi. Mi kimkhat a gitlohna un, a nung uh hong zui hi.
Tua mah bangin a kilang gamtatna hoih a om thei hi, a kilanglo gamtatna hoih a kiseel zo kei hi.
